name: PodcastsToText (Remote)
description: Connects to the hosted PodcastsToText MCP endpoint: transcribe Spotify, Apple Podcasts, YouTube and TikTok links or audio files with speaker labels and timestamps, find a podcast's RSS feed, search your transcripts, and generate show notes, chapters and translations. Requires signing in with a PodcastsToText account (free tier available).
author: PodcastsToText
